block.label: ZERO AND FIRST CONDITIONAL
block.html:
ZERO CONDITIONAL = always true: facts, habits, science.
If + present simple, present simple
If you heat ice, it melts. · If I drink coffee at night, I don't sleep.

FIRST CONDITIONAL = a real possibility in the future.
If + present simple, will / won't + verb
If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home. · If you don't study, you won't pass.

⚠️ Never will after if: ✗ If it will rain… ✓ If it rains…
💡 You can also use a modal in the result: If you feel sick, you should stay home. · If it rains, we might cancel the trip.

block.label: READING · FRIDAY THE 13TH
block.html:
Many people around the world believe in superstitions. In Brazil, people say that if you walk under a ladder, you get bad luck. In many countries, if a black cat crosses your path, it's a bad sign. And if you break a mirror, you have seven years of bad luck! But there is good luck too: if you find a four-leaf clover, you are a lucky person.

Marcos doesn't believe in any of this. Or he didn't, until last Friday. It was Friday the 13th. He was walking to work when a black cat crossed the street in front of him. "That's just a cat," he thought. Five minutes later, while he was waiting for the bus, it started to rain. He didn't have an umbrella. At the office, he was carrying a cup of coffee when he tripped and spilled it on his boss's shirt. In the afternoon, his computer stopped working, and he couldn't send an important report.

That night, Marcos called his grandmother. "Grandma, today everything went wrong!" She laughed. "You should be careful on Fridays the 13th, my dear. If you see a black cat, you must go back home." "Grandma, I can't go back home every time I see a cat!" said Marcos.

Now Marcos is planning next Friday the 13th. "If I stay at home, nothing bad will happen," he says. "And if a black cat comes to my door, I won't open it!"
